examples.title: Basic audio player
examples.description: Play, pause, and seek from the media controls. Only https, http, and blob sources load.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { AudioPlayer } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<AudioPlayer src="https://example.com/media/briefing.mp3" label="Daily briefing" />

examples.title: Unavailable source
examples.description: A source whose scheme is not https, http, or blob never loads and renders the unavailable controls.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { AudioPlayer } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<AudioPlayer src="data:text/html,unsupported" label="Blocked source" />
